name: array-filter
description: Implement a custom array filter function

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript generic function called `customFilter` that takes an array of type T and a predicate function, and returns a new array containing only elements that satisfy the predicate. Include proper generic type annotations. Export the function.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript function called `customFilter` that takes an array and a predicate function, and returns a new array containing only elements that satisfy the predicate. Export the function.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript function called `customFilter` that takes an array and a predicate function, and returns a new array containing only elements that satisfy the predicate. Include JSDoc type annotations with @template, @param and @return tags. Export the function.

testCases.test: const result = customFilter([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], x => x > 3); console.assert(result.length === 2 && result[0] === 4 && result[1] === 5, 'Filter should work');
const result = customFilter(['a', 'ab', 'abc'], x => x.length > 1); console.assert(result.length === 2, 'Filter should work with strings');
